overview: A single Spanish-language web app that consolidates the IGAC Resolución 941 de 2026 appraisal rules into one interactive report, with urban and rural appraisal calculators and a one-click project export.
features: Structured report of Resolución IGAC 941 de 2026 with principles, the four valuation methods and step-by-step formulas
Complete Ross-Heideck coefficient table reproduced exactly as in the technical annex
Urban appraisal calculator covering market, income, cost (Ross-Heideck) and residual techniques
Rural agricultural appraisal calculator using land-rent capitalization
Worked urban and rural examples solved step by step
Exportar Proyecto button that downloads a full report with inputs, formulas and results
Print or PDF output for the appraisal memorandum
